Root old value is the identity here. So C/2-1 gets identity — but C/2-1 should hold inclusive prefix [0..C/2-1] eventually, which comes from the recursive structure within its subtree. Yes — this is how Blelloch works; the parent value zeroed means left subtree exclusive from before. End state: element i holds inclusive scan over [0..i]? In Blelloch, final array holds inclusive scan. But we want exclusive prefix per chunk so that carry[chunk] = compose(exclusive prefix over chunks 0..chunk-1) ∘ initial. Then _block_carries computes a*x+b*y+e where (a..f) is... Let me check what _exclusive_chunks returns. In Blelloch after down-sweep, array holds inclusive scan, element i = combine of [0..i]. Hmm, but then carry for chunk c uses a = inclusive [0..c] ∘ initial, meaning local prefix already includes chunk c, and _apply_prefix applies carry on top of prefix... that would double-count chunk c.
